name: NIH Research Strategy
description: Research Strategy for NIH R01-style applications.
author: ResearchStar

requirements.notes: NIH requires Arial, Helvetica, Palatino Linotype or Georgia at 11 pt or larger, 0.5 in margins, no more than 15 characters per linear inch and 6 lines per vertical inch. The Research Strategy for an R01 is limited to 12 pages; the bibliography is a separate attachment and does not count.
